skills.description: Explore causal boundaries using permitted observations.
exploration: Inspect the permitted initial observation and ask for missing state through Service.
Choose your own business request and supply exact write intentions before Service acts.
Use the actual reply to choose a different prerequisite or boundary to explore.
feedback: Distinguish a claimed outcome from the actual reported tool result.
Record uncertainty for later independent verification; public replies do not expose Oracle verdicts.
hypotheses: A later business request may depend on resource state or available capacity.
stop: Stop when no meaningful independent request remains or the fixed budget is exhausted.
